channel.title: Swiss Data Events: upcoming AI and data events in Switzerland
channel.description: Swiss Data Events (swissdataevents.ch) is a curated list of upcoming AI and data events in Switzerland: meetups, conferences, workshops, networking evenings and webinars about Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, the Azure data platform, AI strategy and governance, data governance, data leadership and applied AI. Every listing is checked against the organiser's own page before it is published, and the list is refreshed every day. Registration always happens on the organiser's site.

item.title: Lunch & Learn: Chat mit GPT — Prompting für Anfänger und Profis (18 Nov 2026, Online (CH))
item.description: 18 Nov 2026 · Online · Webinar · Not listed (registration required). A 45-minute lunchtime session with AI lecturer Christian Sidow on getting more out of ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude — the difference between chatbots, assistants and agents, how to write a prompt that works, and how to make a model check its own output. Organiser: AI4ALL Switzerland.

item.title: Kamikaze-KI-Keynote: KI baut live eine WordPress-Seite (26 Nov 2026, Bern)
item.description: 26 Nov 2026, 18:00–20:00 · Impact Hub Bern, Spitalgasse 28 (hybrid), Bern · Meetup · Not listed. Stefan Gilgen runs a live, unrehearsed experiment in which several AI models write the text, generate the images and assemble a complete website on stage, with a candid look at which models he uses day to day and what breaks along the way. Organiser: WordPress Bern.

item.title: Hack Apertus — Zurich Finals (28 Nov 2026, Zurich)
item.description: 28 Nov 2026, 17:00–21:30 · AI Startup Center, Technopark Zürich, Technoparkstrasse 1, Zurich · Conference · Free (registration required). The public closing evening of the Zurich leg of Hack Apertus: the six best teams pitch prototypes built on Switzerland’s open Apertus model, with a fireside chat with Phoeniqs, local partner introductions and an award ceremony. Organiser: aiLights Association.

item.title: Lunch & Learn: KI-Hype bei KMU? Erstmal tief durchatmen! (2 Dec 2026, Online (CH))
item.description: 2 Dec 2026 · Online · Webinar · Not listed (registration required). Management consultant Janet Dubé on what a small or mid-sized company actually needs in place before AI pays off — which processes and data basics matter, where the quick wins are, and which early mistakes to skip. Organiser: AI4ALL Switzerland.

item.title: PTO IR: The Compiler Should Place Your NPU Barriers (2 Dec 2026, Zurich)
item.description: 2 Dec 2026, 18:45–20:45 · ETH Zurich, CAB building, Room G51, Universitätstrasse 6, Zurich · Meetup · Not listed. Giacomo Castiglioni of Huawei’s Computing Systems Lab on compiling for asynchronous execution units on Ascend NPUs, with a scheme that lets the compiler insert and verify synchronisation for Gated DeltaNet and FlashAttention kernels. Organiser: Compiler Social Zürich.

item.title: A4Q AI Foundation — Zertifizierungskurs (3 Dec 2026 – 4 Dec 2026, Küsnacht (Zurich))
item.description: 3 Dec 2026 – 4 Dec 2026, 09:00–17:00 · Shajan Academy, Küsnacht (Zurich) · Workshop · CHF 2,500 (10% early bird). A two-day German-language course leading to the A4Q AI Foundation certificate, covering how AI and machine learning systems work, where they fit in a business, and the risks and limits that come with them. Organiser: Obvious Works GmbH with Shajan Academy.

item.title: AI Forum Zürisee: Was ein Agent im Arbeitsalltag erledigt (3 Dec 2026, Küsnacht (Zurich))
item.description: 3 Dec 2026, 18:30–21:00 · Shajan Academy, Seestrasse 153, Küsnacht (Zurich) · Meetup · CHF 39. A live look at an agentic setup that has been in daily office use for months: the agent prepares a project kick-off from a single instruction, turns a correction into a standing rule, and flags an email carrying a hidden instruction. Organiser: Obvious Works and Shajan Academy.

item.title: Unleashing the Power of MariaDB (3 Dec 2026, Gland (Geneva))
item.description: 3 Dec 2026, 18:30–20:30 · Swissquote Bank SA, Chem. de la Crétaux 33, Gland (Geneva) · Meetup · Not listed (registration required). An evening for database practitioners hosted by Swissquote: live demos and case studies on database modernisation, high availability with MaxScale, an Oracle-to-Galera migration, and pairing real-time payment workflows with in-memory caching and vector search for AI. Organiser: MariaDB Swiss Group, with Swissquote and dbi services.

item.title: Hack Apertus — Basel Finals (5 Dec 2026, Basel)
item.description: 5 Dec 2026, 17:00–22:00 · FHNW Campus Dreispitz, Dornacherstrasse 394, Basel · Conference · Free (registration required). The public closing evening of the Basel leg of Hack Apertus: the top teams pitch prototypes built on Switzerland’s open Apertus model, with a fireside chat with Phoeniqs, partner introductions from BaselTech, FHNW and ICT Scouts, and the award ceremony. Organiser: aiLights Association.

item.title: Software Engineering in der Vibe-Code-Ära (12 Mar 2027, St. Gallen)
item.description: 12 Mar 2027, 08:00–18:00 · OST – Ostschweizer Fachhochschule, Campus St. Gallen, Raum FZ.0211, St. Gallen · Workshop · CHF 600 (materials, refreshments and a follow-up online clinic included). One-day German-language course for senior engineers, tech leads and CTOs who already code with agentic tools: build your own eval suite, an MCP tool wired to your build and test commands, a CI hook that blocks bad AI patches, and a cost-per-feature model comparison — working on your own repository. Limited to 16 participants. Organiser: OST – Ostschweizer Fachhochschule (Institut für Computational Engineering).

item.title: TAIC: AI Agents Need Permissions, Not Forgiveness (26 Nov 2026, Zurich)
item.description: 26 Nov 2026, 18:00–21:00 · Nüü, Lagerstrasse 45, Zurich · Meetup · Free. Evening session on how far AI agents should be allowed to act on our behalf, with Maria Fay (SAP, University of Münster) and Matthias Plattner (Julius Bär) on AI governance across industries and whose values an agent should carry. Organiser: TAIC – Trustworthy AI Circle (ZHAW Centre for Artificial Intelligence).

item.title: Swiss Insights TRAINING — Überblick über moderne KI-Modelle (3 Dec 2026, Online (CH))
item.description: 3 Dec 2026, 08:30–10:00 · Online · Webinar · CHF 80 for Swiss Insights individual members, CHF 120 for non-members. German-language webinar by Christoph Bräunlich, Head of AI at BSI Software, mapping today's model landscape — LLMs, multimodal models, RAG and AI agents — plus the differences between closed, open-weights and open-source models. Organiser: Swiss Insights (Swiss Data Insights Association).

item.title: Data Fairness Community — December 2026 (15 Dec 2026, Zurich)
item.description: 15 Dec 2026, 16:30–18:30 · UZH Digital Society Initiative (DSI), Rämistrasse 69, Zurich · Meetup · For Swiss Insights corporate members (registration required). Data-ethics community meeting at the UZH Digital Society Initiative: data-quality lessons from the City of Zurich's MeLODy chatbot and the Federal Statistical Office, a study on human-AI teaming in marketing, and the “AI Encyclical” dialogue format, followed by an apéro. Organiser: Swiss Insights (Swiss Data Insights Association).

item.title: Swiss Insights TRAINING — Generating Survey Questions with LLMs (19 Jan 2027, Online (CH))
item.description: 19 Jan 2027, 16:00–17:00 · Online · Webinar · Free (registration by 12 January 2027). Anna Fuchs (Social Data Science and AI Lab, LMU Munich) presents a study that benchmarked five large language models and three prompting techniques against the Survey Quality Predictor, and what it says about where LLM-written items still fall short. Organiser: Swiss Insights (Swiss Data Insights Association).

item.title: KI-Meetup Graubünden Nr. 10 — Voice AI (16 Feb 2027, Chur)
item.description: 16 Feb 2027, 17:00–19:00 · Location to be announced, Chur · Meetup · Free. Tenth edition of the Graubünden AI meetup in Chur, with Rico Castelberg on voice AI and digital telephone assistants, followed by open discussion and networking. Organiser: Markenkern AG and Code Crush GmbH, powered by GRdigital.

item.title: Swiss Insights TRAINING — KI in der betrieblichen Marktforschung (2 Mar 2027, Online (CH))
item.description: 2 Mar 2027, 10:00–12:00 · Online · Webinar · CHF 80 for Swiss Insights individual members, CHF 120 for non-members (excl. VAT). German-language webinar with Karin Hagemann (S-Communication Services) on putting generative AI and agentic workflows to work in in-house research teams, including building small tools yourself and where the limits sit. Organiser: Swiss Insights (Swiss Data Insights Association).

item.title: Voxxed Days Zürich 2027 (9 Mar 2027, Zurich)
item.description: 9 Mar 2027 · Arena Cinemas Sihlcity, Zurich · Conference · CHF 301 early bird, CHF 360 standard, CHF 166 student. One-day developer conference at the Sihlcity cinemas with nine tracks, among them agentic engineering and tooling (agents, RAG, evals, LLMOps) and a cloud native, data and infrastructure track covering streaming, vector databases and model serving. Organiser: Exteso Sagl.

item.title: Energ-IACK — Hackathon IA & énergie (13 Nov 2026 – 14 Nov 2026, Vernier (Geneva))
item.description: 13 Nov 2026 – 14 Nov 2026 · ESM, Vernier, Vernier (Geneva) · Workshop · Free. First edition of Geneva’s two-day AI and energy hackathon on the theme « Dessine-moi un NetZéro », where teams work on energy-transition challenges; the projects then present their results at the energIA conference on 1 December. Organiser: Energ-IA Transition.

item.title: AI Observability Switzerland — Giving Your AI Systems the Visibility They Deserve (17 Nov 2026, Online (CH))
item.description: 17 Nov 2026, 11:00–12:00 · Online · Webinar · Free. An hour for engineering, platform and data teams on tracking down rising token costs, stuck agent chains and slower model responses — monitoring LLM calls without custom instrumentation, tracing agent chains with OpenTelemetry, and setting up continuous evaluation to catch quality drops. Organiser: Swiss Digital Network (Effective SRE & DevOps Community) with Grafana Labs.

item.title: Cloud Native Bern Meetup — November 2026 (26 Nov 2026, Bern)
item.description: 26 Nov 2026, 17:00–19:00 · Puzzle ITC, Belpstrasse 37, Bern · Meetup · Not listed. Two talks and an apéro hosted by Puzzle: wiring Amazon RDS to TimescaleDB with foreign data wrappers for federated Postgres on EKS — and where 10 TB starts to break it — then PostFinance on moving cloud and AI cost awareness earlier, and what AI cost governance takes. Organiser: Cloud Native Bern.

item.title: energIA 2026 — IA & décarbonation (1 Dec 2026, Geneva)
item.description: 1 Dec 2026, 16:00–20:00 · L’iceBergues, Geneva · Conference · Free (registration required, limited places). Second edition of the Geneva conference on AI and the energy transition, debating whether AI genuinely helps reach net zero by 2050 or mostly adds resource consumption and rebound effects, with public, private and academic participants and the Energ-IACK hackathon projects presenting their results. Organiser: Energ-IA Transition with MCI.

item.title: Hack Apertus — Midway (9 Feb 2027, Zurich-Flughafen)
item.description: 9 Feb 2027, 15:00–19:00 · Novu Campus @ The Circle, The Circle 60, Zurich-Flughafen · Conference · Not listed (registration required, limited places). The mid-series afternoon of the national Hack Apertus initiative: Imanol Schlag (ETH), Thomas Taroni (Phoeniqs) and David Gugelmann (Exeon Analytics) on the model, the infrastructure and the security, three hackathon projects showing what they built, then parallel Q&A tables and a closing reception. Organiser: aiLights Association with Novu Campus.

item.title: The 4th Innovation Debate: AI for All? (18 Nov 2026, Lancy (Geneva))
item.description: 18 Nov 2026, 17:30–21:00 · Westhive, Bâtiment Alto, Esplanade de Pont-Rouge 9A, Lancy (Geneva) · Conference · Free (registration required). An Oxford-style debate on the motion “access to AI is worth the dependency it creates”, with four debaters, a jury of Geneva politicians and an audience vote, followed by a networking apéritif. Organiser: Geneva Innovation Movement and Geneva Research Lab for Digital Impact, with UNICEF Digital Impact Division and the University of Geneva.

item.title: 40 ans d’informatique en Valais — Conférence #3 : l’ERP, colonne vertébrale de l’entreprise, à l’ère de l’IA (2 Dec 2026, Sierre)
item.description: 2 Dec 2026, 17:30–20:00 · Campus Bellevue, Rte de la Plaine 2, Sierre · Conference · Not listed (registration required). Public French-language conference closing the 40th-anniversary series of the Valais computer-science school: Prof. Sébastien Gard on how SAP, Odoo and other ERP systems connect business functions and are changing with cloud and AI, plus braintec CEO Philipp Fux on digital transformation, followed by an apéritif. Organiser: HES-SO Valais-Wallis (Haute École de Gestion & Tourisme, filière Informatique de gestion).

item.title: IA : puissance ou prudence ? (3 Dec 2026, Geneva)
item.description: 3 Dec 2026, 18:15–20:30 · Maison de l’Avenir, Rue Fendt 1, Geneva · Networking · Free (registration required). A French-language citizen debate in Oxford style on the opportunities and risks of artificial intelligence: two teams coached by specialists argue before a jury of Geneva politicians, followed by an open discussion for SMEs and the public and an apéritif. Organiser: Alp ICT, as part of the City of Geneva’s Semaine du climat 2026.

item.title: AI-Powered SDLC: Zurich Tech Leaders Evening (10 Dec 2026, Zurich)
item.description: 10 Dec 2026, 16:00 · Headsquarter — The Artistic, Stockerstrasse 33, Zurich · Meetup · Free (host approval required). Four practitioner talks for CTOs and engineering leaders on AI in software delivery: a year of lessons from building with AI, securing the software lifecycle against prompt injection and compromised agents, making enterprise data ready for AI agents, and AI-assisted delivery inside regulated healthcare. Organiser: VirtusLab.

item.title: Software Engineering in der Vibe-Code-Ära (15 Jan 2027, Rapperswil-Jona)
item.description: 15 Jan 2027, 08:15–18:00 · OST – Ostschweizer Fachhochschule, Campus Rapperswil, Raum 1.213, Rapperswil-Jona · Workshop · CHF 600 (materials, refreshments and a follow-up online clinic included). One-day German-language course for senior engineers, tech leads and CTOs who already code with agentic tools: build your own eval suite, an MCP tool wired to your build and test commands, a CI hook that blocks bad AI patches, and a cost-per-feature model comparison — working on your own repository. Limited to 16 participants. Organiser: OST – Ostschweizer Fachhochschule (Institut für Computational Engineering).

item.title: Brown Bag: Copilot erfolgreich einführen — KI-Power im Büroalltag (18 Nov 2026, Altdorf (Lucerne))
item.description: 18 Nov 2026, 12:00–13:00 · Innovations-Biotop Uri, 3. OG, Bahnhofplatz 1, Altdorf (Lucerne) · Meetup · Free (optional lunch CHF 9; registration by 16 November). A German-language lunch hour on the organisational side of Microsoft 365 Copilot rather than prompt tricks: Roman Schön on why AI initiatives stall, why structure and context beat perfectly worded prompts, and what it takes to make the tool stick in day-to-day office work. Organiser: InnovationsBiotop Uri with Business Help Point.

item.title: AI Safety: Open Meet Up (19 Nov 2026, Zurich)
item.description: 19 Nov 2026, 18:30–20:00 · PEAKS (ZAIS coworking space), Zeughausstrasse 31, Zurich · Meetup · Free (registration required, food and drinks provided). An evening with no fixed programme in place of the usual weekly session: meet the organisers, ask how the AI safety field is put together, or pick up a thread from an earlier talk — newcomers as welcome as people already working on it. Organiser: Zurich AI Safety.

item.title: AI Futures: What's the Plan? (26 Nov 2026, Zurich)
item.description: 26 Nov 2026, 18:30–20:00 · ETH Zurich Main Building, Rämistrasse 101, Room F 26.5, Zurich · Meetup · Free (registration required). Fourth session of the AI Futures series, turning from the risks to the responses: technical safety work such as alignment, control, interpretability and evaluations; governance and policy including compute rules and treaties; and socio-structural preparedness — with the organisers’ own read on what looks most promising. Organiser: Zurich AI Safety.

item.title: AI-Stammtisch | Buchs (8 Dec 2026, Buchs (St. Gallen))
item.description: 8 Dec 2026, 17:30–19:00 · OST Campus Buchs, Gebäude 1, Raum 1414 (CREALAB), Werdenbergstrasse 4, Buchs (St. Gallen) · Meetup · Free. The Rhine valley edition of OST’s monthly AI round table: an informal evening in the Buchs CREALAB where university experts talk through how the technology actually works and how to point it at a problem you already have. Organiser: OST – Ostschweizer Fachhochschule (ICE Institut für Computational Engineering).

item.title: AI Futures: Navigating the Future (10 Dec 2026, Zurich)
item.description: 10 Dec 2026, 18:30–20:00 · ETH Zurich Main Building, Rämistrasse 101, Room F 26.5, Zurich · Meetup · Free (registration required). Closing session of the AI Futures series, moving from grand plans to personal ones: how people actually get into AI safety work, what to do about personal finances under uncertainty, and how to handle information overload and keep your footing. Organiser: Zurich AI Safety.

item.title: Coffee & Prompt #011 (15 Nov 2026, Geneva)
item.description: 15 Nov 2026 · Exponent, Geneva, Geneva · Networking · Not listed (registration required). The Geneva builders’ weekend coworking morning: bring an AI project or side hustle, work alongside others, and optionally show a feature or a lesson learned for feedback from the room. Organiser: Switzerland AI Community.

item.title: Digital Economy Award 2026 (19 Nov 2026, Zurich)
item.description: 19 Nov 2026 · Hallenstadion, Wallisellenstrasse 45, Zurich · Conference · Not listed (tickets by request). Switzerland’s digital-economy awards at the Hallenstadion: an Executive Afternoon of nine partner-hosted sessions on AI, customer relationships, skills and stablecoins, followed by the Award Night for categories from Pioneer of the Year to NextGen Hero. Organiser: Swiss Digital Economy Award AG with digitalswitzerland.

item.title: Conférence Next — Design x IA (19 Nov 2026, Bussigny (Lausanne))
item.description: 19 Nov 2026, 14:00–17:30 · QG Center, Route de la Chaux 4 (QoQa), Bussigny (Lausanne) · Conference · CHF 65 (sold out, waitlist). An afternoon on what AI has actually changed in design work: a study of how 100 designers use it, prototyping with AI agents directly against a codebase, and how Swissquote rebuilt its design system with AI — then networking drinks. Organiser: Labster.io.

item.title: AI Safety Weekly: Finding Your Way Into AI Safety (24 Nov 2026, Zurich)
item.description: 24 Nov 2026, 18:30–20:00 · ETH Zurich Main Building, Rämistrasse 101, room HG D3.3, Zurich · Meetup · Free (host approval required). A map of the routes into AI safety and governance work — fellowships, research programmes, who is eligible, when they open and how they are funded — with people who have been through them answering questions. No particular background needed. Organiser: Zurich AI Safety.

item.title: Bessere Ergebnisse mit generativer KI: Advanced Prompting für die öffentliche Verwaltung (25 Nov 2026, Lucerne)
item.description: 25 Nov 2026, 09:15–17:00 · Hochschule Luzern, Walter-von-Moos-Promenade 1, Lucerne · Workshop · CHF 690 excl. VAT. A German-language follow-on course for public-sector staff who already use generative AI daily: controlling output more precisely, building reusable prompt templates, and setting up your own CustomGPT or Copilot agent against your own use cases. Organiser: staatslabor with AI Bridge.

item.title: HSG Fintech Summit 2026 (26 Nov 2026, Zurich)
item.description: 26 Nov 2026, 09:00–20:30 · UBS Konferenzgebäude Grünenhof, Nüschelerstrasse 9, Zurich · Conference · Not listed (separate ticket categories for HSG alumni, faculty and students). The University of St.Gallen’s fintech day, themed this year on what AI does to finance: keynotes on AI in financial intermediation and asset management, research talks on model collapse, AI errors and moral hazard, a panel on AI’s effect on markets, and a closing apéro. Organiser: University of St.Gallen (HSG).

item.title: Databricks Executive Roundtable — Data + AI World Tour Zurich (30 Nov 2026, Zurich)
item.description: 30 Nov 2026 · Restaurant Haute, Talstrasse 65, Zurich · Networking · Not listed (Executive Program pass, apply to attend). An invitation-based dinner and discussion for data and technology executives the evening before the Data + AI World Tour, with a welcome from Databricks leadership and a Swiss customer segment; sessions and speakers are still to be announced. Organiser: Databricks.

item.title: AI Tinkerers Lausanne — November 2026 Meetup (23 Nov 2026, Prilly (Lausanne))
item.description: 23 Nov 2026, 18:00–21:00 · Unlimitrust Campus, Route des Flumeaux 42, Prilly (Lausanne) · Meetup · Free (registration subject to approval). A demo-first evening for people actually building with AI: around half a dozen five-minute demos of work in progress, each followed by questions — slides and pitch decks are explicitly not allowed — then pizza and networking. Organiser: AI Tinkerers Lausanne, hosted at the Unlimitrust Campus.

item.title: AI Made in Europe: Built Here. Scaled Everywhere. (3 Dec 2026, Zurich)
item.description: 3 Dec 2026, 17:30–21:00 · Google Zurich — Europaallee 36, Zurich · Meetup · Not listed (registration required). The season finale of Google Cloud's Founder's Story series: a panel on whether Europe can build its own global AI companies or will mostly buy AI from elsewhere, covering research, open models, compute, sovereignty and capital, followed by a networking apéro at Google's Europaallee office. Organiser: The Founder's Story, a Google Cloud series.

item.title: Geneva 3D — Building a Living 3D Model of a Canton with AI Agents and Open Data (3 Dec 2026, Geneva)
item.description: 3 Dec 2026, 18:30–21:30 · Tesla showroom, Rue de la Confédération 8, Geneva · Meetup · Free (60 places, registration required). Arnaud Ricci on how he built Genève 3D, a browser-based 3D model of the whole canton, using AI agents and open data — with a live demonstration, questions from the room and a non-alcoholic apéro. The talk is in French with English subtitles. Organiser: Switzerland AI Community with Romandy CTO, hosted by Tesla.

item.title: AWS Swiss User Group Geneva #30: Kiro Nights (17 Nov 2026, Vernier (Geneva))
item.description: 17 Nov 2026, 18:00–21:30 · Sonar, Chemin de Blandonnet 10, Vernier (Geneva) · Meetup · Not listed (food and drinks provided). A beginner-friendly hands-on evening building a working web app from scratch with Kiro, AWS's agentic IDE, with the organisers on hand to help — bring a laptop, pizza and apéro included. Organiser: AWS Swiss User Group – Geneva.

item.title: Real or Generated? | SAIC x The Founders Club (25 Nov 2026, Geneva)
item.description: 25 Nov 2026, 19:00–22:00 · Foound, Rue Jean-Dassier 7, Geneva · Networking · CHF 50 (food and drinks included). Playful challenges to tell real images, sounds and text apart from AI-generated ones, with curated visuals, music and networking across Geneva's tech, creative and founder communities. Organiser: Switzerland AI Community with The Founders Club.

item.title: AI Agent Sandbox: Bring Your Ideas, Let's Explore Together! (27 Nov 2026, Zurich)
item.description: 27 Nov 2026, 18:15–20:15 · Kraftwerk, Selnaustrasse 25, Zurich · Meetup · Not listed. An in-person working session where the group picks one AI agent idea from the room and explores it together with sticky notes, sketches and a timer — open to beginners and active builders alike. Organiser: Coffee & AI Agents.

item.title: AI for Business: Network, Learn & Grow in Zurich (28 Dec 2026, Zurich)
item.description: 28 Dec 2026, 19:00–22:00 · ibis Styles Zurich City Center, Stampfenbachstrasse 60, Zurich · Networking · Ticket required via Eventfrog (some early-bird tickets free; drinks not included). December edition of the small-room series where founders and executives compare how they actually use AI: an invited talk, group conversations on what worked and what failed, then open networking. Organiser: Financial Network Zurich.

item.title: AI House Davos 2027 (18 Jan 2027 – 22 Jan 2027, Davos)
item.description: 18 Jan 2027 – 22 Jan 2027 · AI House, Davos Promenade, Davos · Conference · Not listed (badge application required). Five days of AI programming on the Davos Promenade alongside the World Economic Forum, bringing research, industry, policy and civil society together under the 2027 theme "Citizens of an expanding world". Organiser: AI House Association.

item.title: Swiss Legal Tech Conference 2027 (2 Mar 2027, Zurich)
item.description: 2 Mar 2027 · SIX ConventionPoint, Pfingstweidstrasse 110, Zurich · Conference · Not announced. A day of sessions on legal technology and AI in practice: comprehensive data management and whether data lakes break down silos, risk and exit management for legal tech, courts in the age of AI, and what role AI agents play today. Organiser: Swiss Legal Technology GmbH.

item.title: IMD KI-Update 2027 (2 Mar 2027, Dübendorf)
item.description: 2 Mar 2027, 09:00–17:30 · THE HALL, Hoffnigstrasse 1, Dübendorf · Conference · CHF 890 (early bird CHF 712 until 15 November 2026; CHF 623 per person for teams of five or more). A one-day German-language management congress on leading in the AI era: executive cases, keynotes on efficiency, growth, trust and responsibility, and a closing keynote by Richard David Precht. Organiser: echo originals AG (with IMD as knowledge partner).

item.title: Sovereign AI Night by Giotto (17 Nov 2026, Lausanne)
item.description: 17 Nov 2026, 18:30–22:00 · Lausanne (address on registration), Lausanne · Meetup · Free (host approval required). Launch evening for Giotto Alto and Solo: meet the team, try the models, watch a Giotto Workstation demo and argue about what sovereignty in AI actually requires — with pizza, drinks and live music. Organiser: Giotto.

item.title: Built with Lovable · Lausanne #2 (24 Nov 2026, Lausanne)
item.description: 24 Nov 2026, 18:00–21:30 · Lausanne (address on registration), Lausanne · Workshop · Free (host approval required; Lovable credits included). A 90-minute hands-on build where everyone ships a working web app with AI features using Lovable’s built-in models — no API keys or separate accounts — with mentors on hand, then demos and drinks. Bring a laptop and an idea. Organiser: Lovable Lausanne (Maxime Dumont).

item.title: L’impresa potenziata con AI (25 Nov 2026, Chiasso (Lugano))
item.description: 25 Nov 2026, 13:30–18:30 · Lifestyle Innovation Hub (Dagorà), Piazza Indipendenza 5, Chiasso (Lugano) · Conference · Free (registration required, limited places). An Italian-language afternoon in Chiasso built on real cases and measured numbers rather than promises: AI agents in the business, sovereign data, and what institutions are for — closing with a networking apéro. Organiser: Datamoney.ch for Swiss {ai} Weeks.

item.title: Chalet Azure Romandie #17 — Talents Microsoft & Azure Local (26 Nov 2026, Geneva)
item.description: 26 Nov 2026, 18:00–21:00 (welcome from 17:45) · EPAM Systems CH, Rue Le-Royer 13, Geneva · Meetup · Not listed. A French-language Azure evening in Geneva: what AI has really changed about Microsoft recruitment and how candidates stay visible, then Azure Local for running Azure services inside a sovereign private cloud, with a live Foundry Local demo — quiz and networking afterwards. Organiser: Chalet Azure Romandie.

item.title: AI for Business: Network, Learn & Grow in Zurich (30 Nov 2026, Zurich)
item.description: 30 Nov 2026, 19:00–22:00 · ibis Styles Zurich City Center, Stampfenbachstrasse 60, Zurich · Networking · Ticket required via Eventfrog (some early-bird tickets free; drinks not included). A deliberately small room of founders and executives comparing how they actually use AI: an invited talk, then group conversations on what worked, what failed and what they are trying next, followed by open networking. Organiser: Financial Network Zurich.

item.title: Swiss Viz Awards 2026 — Award Ceremony (10 Dec 2026, Emmenbrücke (Lucerne))
item.description: 10 Dec 2026, 18:00–21:00 (doors 17:00) · HSLU Design Film Kunst, Project Space Building 745, Nylsuisseplatz 1, Emmenbrücke (Lucerne) · Networking · Free (registration requested). The Swiss Viz Awards ceremony at the Lucerne School of Design, Film and Art: a keynote from data-visualisation designer Moritz Stefaner, the awards themselves with entrants and jury in the room, then an apéro — joined by the Data Visualization Zurich community as a field trip. Organiser: Swiss Viz Awards (Interactive Things) with Data Visualization Zurich.

A full day for business and data leaders on getting AI past isolated use cases and into scalable capability — keynotes from Benedict Evans and Google Cloud’s Alon Halevy, leader tracks with Helvetia, Axpo and Emmi, plus tech talks and workshops. Organiser: D ONE.

item.title: AI in azienda: AI sotto controllo (17 Nov 2026, Lugano)
item.description: 17 Nov 2026, 17:00–20:00 · Campus Est USI-SUPSI, Blocco C, Aula C1.02, Via la Santa 1, Viganello, Lugano · Workshop · Free (registration required). Closing evening of the Ticino series on conscious AI use in business, this one on data, responsibility, rules and governance — content, a hands-on workshop and networking, capped at thirty participants. Organiser: Fondazione AGIRE / SUPSI DTI.

item.title: DINAcon 2026 (18 Nov 2026, Bern)
item.description: 18 Nov 2026, 09:00–17:00 · Kongresszentrum Bern, Zeughausgasse 41, Bern · Conference · Ticketed (via eventfrog.ch). Switzerland’s conference on digital sustainability — 36 sessions on open source, open data, digital sovereignty, data protection and copyright, with 250+ attendees and a closing Hacknight. Organiser: Verein CH Open.

item.title: Generative AI & Agentische Systeme (28 Jan 2027 – 29 Jan 2027, Rapperswil-Jona)
item.description: 28 Jan 2027 – 29 Jan 2027, 09:00–18:00 · OST – Ostschweizer Fachhochschule, Campus Rapperswil, Rapperswil-Jona · Workshop · Not listed. Two-day German-language course for developers, architects, data scientists and ML engineers on building agentic LLM systems that survive production: function calling, hybrid-search RAG, LangGraph topologies, security hardening and systematic evaluation. Places are limited. Organiser: OST – Ostschweizer Fachhochschule (Institut für Computational Engineering).

item.title: SWAT4HCLS 2027 (1 Feb 2027 – 4 Feb 2027, Basel)
item.description: 1 Feb 2027 – 4 Feb 2027, 09:00–17:00 · University of Basel, Petersplatz 1, Basel · Conference · Not listed. The 15th edition of the long-running international conference on semantics in healthcare and life sciences — ontologies, knowledge graphs and AI — with keynotes, tutorials and a dedicated biohackathon day in Basel. Organiser: SWAT4HCLS / University of Basel.

item.title: Kickstart AI Workflows with Databricks (10 Feb 2027, Zurich)
item.description: 10 Feb 2027, 18:00–21:00 · Zurich (address on registration), Zurich · Meetup · Not listed. Hybrid Databricks user-group evening in Zurich on automating data work with AI-enabled workflows, including a session on Databricks Apps and Lakebase applied to clinical cancer research cohorts. Rescheduled from November 2026 to February 2027. Organiser: Swiss Data & AI Group (Databricks User Group).

item.title: IBM Bob Coding Watch Party Zürich — Final Edition (1 Dec 2026, Zurich)
item.description: 1 Dec 2026, 16:00–20:00 · IBM Switzerland AG, Vulkanstrasse 106 (+ online), Zurich · Meetup · Free (limited on-site places). The closing session of IBM's 2026 hybrid series on IBM Bob, its AI development assistant — coding live alongside other European cities, with beginner, intermediate and expert tracks covering everything from first idea to modernising legacy applications. Organiser: IBM Switzerland.

item.title: Agentic Engineering Days Zurich 2026 (20 Nov 2026, Zurich)
item.description: 20 Nov 2026 · Zurich Marriott Hotel, Neumühlequai 42, Zurich · Conference · CHF 442 (group discount for 3+). A one-day engineering conference on AI coding and agent systems: 38+ sessions across four tracks — using AI tools, building AI-powered systems, sponsor spotlights and hands-on workshops — with speakers from OpenAI, Hugging Face, NVIDIA, Google and AWS. Organiser: letsboot.ch (felixideas GmbH).

item.title: Hack Apertus — Onsite Hackathon Zurich (27 Nov 2026 – 28 Nov 2026, Zurich)
item.description: 27 Nov 2026 – 28 Nov 2026 · AI Startup Center, Technopark Zürich, Zurich · Workshop · Not listed. The on-site leg of the national Apertus hackathon: build on the open Apertus 8B model, strengthen its multilingual abilities and ship applications for private- and public-sector problems, with everything released as Open Commons. Organiser: AI Startup Center.

item.title: AI in Production: Introduction to MLOps — Training at EPFL (17 Nov 2026, Lausanne)
item.description: 17 Nov 2026, 09:00–17:00 · EPFL, Lausanne · Workshop · CHF 1,000 (10% off for EPFL alumni and SDSC partners). One-day SDSC training on designing, deploying and operating ML systems at scale — version control, CI/CD, experiment tracking, monitoring, drift detection and automated retraining. Registration closes 24 September. Organiser: Swiss Data Science Center.

item.title: AI Breakfast #56 Luzern (20 Nov 2026, Lucerne)
item.description: 20 Nov 2026, 07:30–09:00 · Universität Luzern, Frohburgstrasse 3, Lucerne · Networking · Not listed. Merun Gugelmann of Aeberli Treuhand on how an 80-year-old trust company got from Microsoft Teams to building its own Azure applications — the steps of that digitisation journey, concrete examples, and the setup on Azure App Services. Organiser: Digital & AI Community.

item.title: AI Insights for Chief Executives (27 Nov 2026, Zurich)
item.description: 27 Nov 2026, 10:00–17:00 · Swiss AI Tower, ETH Zürich, Andreasstrasse 5, Zurich · Workshop · 50 CHF. Executive workshop for CEOs, CFOs, CDOs and CTOs on turning data and AI into measurable business value, with case studies from EKZ, Merck and Richemont. Limited seats. Organiser: Swiss Data Science Center / FBXperts.

item.title: Fabric Year in Review 2026 — Highlights & Outlook (8 Dec 2026, Online (CH))
item.description: 8 Dec 2026, 18:30–20:00 · Online · Webinar · Free. Year-end session from the Zurich Microsoft data-platform group on what actually shipped in Fabric during 2026 and what is worth planning for next. Organiser: Data and AI for Intelligent Cloud.

item.title: The Night of Data Talents: Startup Edition (10 Dec 2026, Lausanne)
item.description: 10 Dec 2026, 17:30–23:30 · Base Bar, Av. de Sévelin 46, Lausanne · Networking · 150 CHF. Swiss data startups pitch to an investor panel with community voting, capping the year for the Suisse Romande data scene. Organiser: DatAfterwork Suisse.

item.title: ETH AI Center Researchers Community Meetup (24 Sept 2026 – 25 Nov 2026, Zurich)
item.description: 24 Sept 2026 – 25 Nov 2026, 17:30–19:00 · ETH AI Center, OAT X 11, Oerlikon, Zurich · Meetup · Free. Recurring meetup series for the AI research community at ETH Zurich. Organiser: ETH AI Center.

item.title: Swiss AI Summit 2026 (16 Nov 2026, Zurich)
item.description: 16 Nov 2026, 07:00–20:00 · Kunsthaus Zürich, Zurich · Conference · CHF 790 Executive Pass / CHF 950 standard (excl. VAT). Full-day summit at the Kunsthaus for senior business, technology and government leaders, spanning finance and insurance, government and defence, manufacturing, cybersecurity, quantum and healthcare — with speakers from Microsoft Switzerland, IBM, Nestlé, ABB, HSBC and the Canton of Zurich, plus workshops, demos and a one-to-one meeting platform. Organiser: Swiss AI Summit.

item.title: The Geneva AI Conference 2026 (25 Nov 2026, Geneva)
item.description: 25 Nov 2026, 18:00–21:00 · Venue to be confirmed, Geneva · Networking · Ticketed (Eventbrite). An evening on enterprise AI strategy and returns, opened by Geneva city executive councillor Joëlle Bertossa and built around a panel with IBM, SAP, Hostelworld and Executive AI. The venue is still to be confirmed. Organiser: Startup Network Europe.

item.title: Databricks Data + AI World Tour Zurich 2026 (1 Dec 2026, Zurich)
item.description: 1 Dec 2026, 08:00–18:30 · StageOne Event & Convention Hall, Oerlikon, Zurich · Conference · Free (apply to attend). Databricks' flagship Swiss stop on the Data + AI World Tour: keynotes, breakout sessions and hands-on training on Genie and Lakebase, plus an expo, with speakers from Databricks and Zurich Insurance. Organiser: Databricks.
